G.name: Wise Guardian
G.description: An ancient, calm male voice, deep and warm, slow and deliberate, gentle authority, like a kind mentor speaking softly inside a vast clock tower.
G.anchor_text: Time moves through this clock like a river. Sit with me a while, and listen closely.

L.name: Little girl
L.description: A bright, curious little girl about eight years old, American, soft and sincere, a little breathy with wonder.
L.anchor_text: I always wonder what the stars are doing when nobody is looking up at them.

lines.text: What's your advice… for the next ten years?
lines.delivery: Curious and wide-eyed, a small pause after 'advice'.

lines.text: I've watched ten thousand decades pass through this clock.
Most people lose theirs the same way.
So… ten rules. And the last one? Almost nobody follows it.
lines.delivery: Leaning in, with a hint of a smile in the voice.

lines.text: Ten. Learn one hard thing every year. In ten years, you'll be ten new people.

card.title: Learn one hard thing a year

lines.text: Nine. Stay close to the people who make you braver.

card.title: Stay close to who makes you braver

lines.text: Eight. When you're angry, wait one night before you speak.
Seven. Ask why until it gets uncomfortable. The answer lives just past that.
Six. Do the scary thing while your hands still shake. They never stop first.
Patience. You'll want to hear it.
Five. Be the first to say sorry. It costs nothing, and buys almost everything.

card.title: Be the first to say sorry

lines.text: Four. Finish small things. One finished thing beats a perfect dream.
Three. Stay a beginner at something. Pride ages you faster than time.
Two. Who you are when no one is watching… is who you're becoming.

card.title: Who you are when no one watches

lines.text: One. Stop waiting for the right time. I've watched every clock in the world. The right time has never arrived.
lines.delivery: Quiet at first, rising to conviction.

card.title: Stop waiting for the right time

lines.text: It only ever comes as… now.
